title: FastMCP
oneLiner: Pythonic framework for building MCP servers and clients.
summary: FastMCP is an Apache-2.0 Python project for building Model Context Protocol servers and clients with a developer-friendly API.
whyItMatters: MCP servers are becoming a common connector layer for agents. FastMCP gives Python builders a faster way to expose tools and data sources through that protocol.
bestFor: Teams turning internal tools into agent-accessible connectors
Builders prototyping MCP clients and servers quickly
notFor: Teams that need a TypeScript-first MCP SDK
Users who are not building MCP integrations
seoTitle: FastMCP: Python framework for MCP servers and clients
seoDescription: FastMCP profile: Python MCP server and client framework, official links, command line, and OpenAgent structured data.
shareDescription: Pythonic framework for building MCP servers and clients.
